description: How a TmTabs strip behaves when the tabs do not fit the available width.

values.name: Scroll
values.description: The default: the strip stays on one row and scrolls horizontally (the historical behavior), with token-coloured edge shadows over the clipped tabs.

values.name: Wrap
values.description: The strip wraps onto multiple rows to fit the available width — the layout the legacy Wrap boolean opted into, now a first-class value.
